In the context of a hypothetical, write the jacket blurb for a thriller where a modern day operative of the FBI, ends up back in the early 1960's having to use her knowledge of "future" forensics to leave clues to enable her modern colleagues to catch a time-hopping serial-killer, before he dies.assistant
response: "When FBI operative Rachel Jenkins is sent back in time to the early 1960s, she finds herself in the midst of a decades-old nightmare. A time-hopping serial killer, known only as 'The Archon,' has been leaving a trail of bodies across the country, and Rachel's unique knowledge of future forensics is the only hope for catching him. With the help of a local detective, Jack Harris, Rachel must use her expertise to leave clues that will lead her modern colleagues to the killer's next victim. But as she navigates the unfamiliar world of 1960s America, Rachel realizes that The Archon is always one step ahead, and that she may be the only one who can stop him before it's too late.
